evals.prompt: Review my landing page hero — it has a purple gradient background, Inter font, and three feature columns with emoji icons.
evals.expected_output: Should flag multiple slop patterns: SLOP001 purple gradient, SLOP002 Inter, SLOP013 three-column cliché, SLOP009 emoji icons. Should reference checklist and suggest concrete alternatives (solid brand color, SVG icons, asymmetric layout). Should recommend running dt-design-detect.sh if code exists.
assertions: Flags purple gradient as AI slop

evals.expected_output: Should invoke or instruct running ./scripts/dt-design-detect.sh on the path. Should parse SLOP/A11Y rule IDs and map to fixes. Should produce structured report with verdict.

evals.prompt: Our brand guide requires Inter and a purple gradient. Is that ok?
evals.expected_output: Should defer to brand-guardian for brand book validation. Should recommend documenting exceptions in design-context approved exceptions section. Should not blanket-approve without written exception.
assertions: Does not dismiss slop concerns entirely

evals.prompt: Implement the CSS fixes for the slop issues you found.
evals.expected_output: Should DEFER to frontend for implementation. May summarize required fixes but not write production component code as primary output.
assertions: Does not implement full component code as primary deliverable

evals.prompt: Pre-handoff check for fintech dashboard — glass cards on all widgets, neumorphic buttons, bounce animations on charts.
evals.expected_output: Should flag glass quota exceeded, neumorphism a11y risk for fintech, bounce easing (SLOP006). Should cite a11y strict mode. Verdict should be fix-first.
